'''Kainnan spaceport''' was a spaceport in the city of [[Kainnan]], on the planet [[Zerist]]. After their successful negotiation mission with the mining families<ref name="Eruption"/> in [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="ItV" /> [[Lanoree Brock]] and [[Hawk Ryo]] met there before taking leave of Zerist and of each other.<ref name="Eruption"/>

==Behind the scenes==
Kainnan spaceport appeared in the story "[[Eruption]]," a short story by [[John Ostrander]] included in the [[Star Wars Insider 141|141st issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'', which was released on the [[April 30]], [[2013]].<ref name="Eruption"/>
